desc: 珊瑚粉撞色颜值、折叠伸缩便携、双色可选与重低音环绕的头戴蓝牙耳机套图
leaf: 撞色折叠头戴式蓝牙耳机
name: 撞色少女折叠便携头戴耳机款

shots.intent: 粉调渐变加悬浮产品与声波环，一秒立住撞色颜值与声效主张，承接点击。
shots.textZone: top-center headline in deep charcoal #2D2D2D with one rounded coral-red pill label below; bottom of frame a white arc band with one short centered caption

shots.intent: 白卡六宫格图标把核心功能一次扫完，让买家十秒内建立全貌认知。
shots.textZone: inside the card a two-column three-row grid: one short charcoal label under each icon plus one tiny light-grey English microlabel

shots.intent: 微仰正面中景加脉冲声波线，把重低音临场感做成一眼可感的核心卖点。
shots.textZone: upper area: one small coral-red pill label with a music-note icon plus a centered headline and one short centered sub-line

shots.intent: 正上方俯视特写加两点标注线，把折叠与伸缩两处机关讲成可信的结构证据。
shots.textZone: two coral-red dot markers on the hinge and slider with thin leader lines to short labels; centered short headline above

shots.intent: 折叠平放实拍配短线缆道具，让收纳便携从口号变成看得见的形态。
shots.textZone: small centered label block above: short charcoal headline with one tiny light-grey sub-line

shots.intent: 深炭底上双配色斜向叠放加圆形昵称牌，锁定配色选择、减少比价流失。
shots.textZone: top-left small pill label; one soft light circular tag floating near each variant with color name and one short playful sub-line

shots.intent: 正面居中加大字背景排版，把无线自由与轻便舒适转成年轻化的出街主张。
shots.textZone: top-center short headline; right side a small vertical stack of three short labels with thin underline ticks

shots.intent: 深炭圆角参数卡分两列排布规格条目，一次消除续航、连接、重量类疑虑并收尾。
shots.textZone: top edge of the card a small white notch tab with the title; inside a two-column table of six rows, spec labels left and short white value lines right
